messages:
incident-bot: Paging: p99 streaming stalls on us-east-1 serving fleet - SLO alert firing for decode tail latency (p99 > 2s). Auto-paging to #eng-oncall. Links: https://grafana.redwood/prod	streaming/p99
sara: on it. seeing alerts too. any rollouts in the last 30m?
mike: yes, there was a runtime kernel image push at 14:02 UTC -> trt8 + flashattn kernels + new compile flag -Xcompiler=fastdecode
mike: quick metrics: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~420ms, p99 jumped from ~700ms to 2.4s since 14:05 UTC. Streaming stalls show tail spikes aligned w/ decode ops
elaine: customer reports: AcmeCorp chatbots time out intermittently during long responses. Support ticket #12345 opened. ETA 30m SLA risk.
drew: that runtime image included compilepath change: kernel scheduling + flashattn fast-path enabled. suspect KV cache eviction + new kernel causing pagefaults under concurrency
sara: can we confirm kernel logs? mike can you paste the `dmesg` / OOM / pagefault traces (sanitized)
mike: log snippet:
```
[14:06:13] nvidia: page fault at 0x7f2a3... rw
[14:06:14] runtime: decode tail stall: waiting on KV cache lock
[14:06:14] flashattn: kernel launch latency 12ms -> 400ms
```
drew: that matches a transient compilepath codegen regression. we saw something similar in canary earlier but didn't hit threshold. disabling flashattn fast-path reduces pressure. recommend rollback to last known-good image (sha: abc123)
sara: rollback approved. infra-bot: can you start a rollback? mark high priority. :rotating_light:
infra-bot: Received: rollback request for rtf-serving-prod -> rolling to image abc123 across us-east-1. Canary: 5 pods. Command:
```
kubectl set image deployment/rtf-serving rtf-server=registry.redwood/rtf-server:abc123 -n prod
```
infra-bot: canary started (5 pods). Will report canary metrics in ~2m
ops-lead: watching canary. p99 on canary pods dropped from 2.3s -> 980ms within 90s. no errors in logs so far.
elaine: reaching out to AcmeCorp with ETA and workaround (set streaming.max_tokens=1024) :phone:
drew: plan for root cause: reproduce with load test, bisect compileflag that enabled kernel fusion, and add safety gate to prevent flashattn fast-path toggles in emergency channels
sara: handoff to runtime for postmortem and next steps. oncall clear once rollback finishes and customer confirmed. assign to @drew for RCA and mitigation PR
mike: final numbers post-rollback (us-east-1): p99 950ms, p95 380ms, error rate back to baseline
sara: thanks team. I'll update incident timeline and notify support to close or escalate ticket. handoff: runtime owns RCA, infra to improve canary thresholds, support to follow up with customer.
incident-bot: Incident closed: status=mitigated, mitigation=rollback -> image abc123, duration=18m, impacted_customers=1 (AcmeCorp). Runbook: create postmortem and link it in #incidents
